title: CDCLocator working guidance
text: CDCLocator development-stage R client HIV.gov Locator API (https://locator-api.hiv.gov). finds HIV related service providers near ZIP code, city state, point, returns tibbles. R/request.R: .cdc_locator_request() builds every request (base URL, auth headers, query, timeout) .perform_cdc_locator_request() performs , checks status parses JSON. API calls go two helpers. R/auth.R: .build_auth_headers() finds credentials (arguments first, CDC_LOCATOR_CLIENT_ID CDC_LOCATOR_CLIENT_TOKEN environment variables); cdc_locator_set_credentials() helps user add .Renviron. R/providers.R: cdc_providers(), providers within radius ZIP code. R/providers_tidy.R: cdc_providers_tidy(), flattens nested provider columns returned cdc_providers(). R/address_place.R, R/address_point.R: cdc_address_place() cdc_address_point(), translate city state latitude longitude ZIP code. R/enums.R: valid services values validator. R/utils.R: small internal helpers. Read relevant source documentation advising changing . package tests CI yet; describe behavior tested .
